test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 25 Jan 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In an election Santosh got 24000 more votes than Mantosh. If Mantosh and Santosh got 30% and 40% of the total votes respectively. Find the total number of votes cast.
solution:
**Given:**

Santosh got 24000 more votes than Mantosh

Mantosh and Santosh got 30% and 40% of the total votes respectively

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

10% = 24000

1% = 2400

100% = 240000

Therefore, total number of votes are 240000.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** **Concept: **

Calculation of total votes based on percentage shares of candidates.

**Solution:**

Let the total number of votes be X

As per the question,

Santosh's votes (40% of X) = Mantosh's votes (30% of X) + 24000

⇒ 40/100 × X = 30/100 × X + 24000

⇒ 10/100 × X = 24000

⇒ X = 240000

**Therefore, total number of votes are 240000.**
